shortDescription: Brazil’s Chief Justice Edson Fachin gave the Federal Police 24 hours to provide information on the custody and condition of data extracted from the mobile phone of Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, according to Bloomberg.The ruling was issued this Saturday.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Brazil Top Court Orders Police to Explain Banker Phone Data
